1.name: Aura of Vampirism
1.description: An aura which causes the Melee and Ranged attacks of your group to have a chance to drain life from your enemies, dealing 1 (L1) to 30 (L60) damage and healing.

1.name: Draw Strength
1.description: Draws the Strength of an enemy target, reducing their Strength by 2 and increasing your own Strength by 2 for 5 minutes.
1.valuesSummary: −2 Strength · −2 increasing your own Strength · +2 own Strength

1.name: Locate Corpse
1.description: Locates a target player's nearest corpse.

1.name: Polar Align: North
1.description: Magically align yourself, orienting you toward the North Pole.

1.name: Shoot
1.description: Shoots your target with a bow. (requires bow & arrows)

1.name: Slam
1.description: Forcefully slam your target, dealing 100% Weapon Damage plus 1 (L1) to 20 (L60) Physical Damage, and increasing your Threat by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60). Has a chance to stun from behind the target.

1.name: Taunt
1.description: Taunt your target, causing them to focus their attacks on you. Triggers cooldown of Martial abilities.

2.name: Life Drain
2.description: Drains your target's life force, dealing 3 (L1) to 5 (L4) damage and healing you for the same amount.

2.name: Spirit Break
2.description: Breaks your target's resistance to the spirits, decreasing their Corruption, Holy, and Magic Resistance by 1 (L1) to 2 (L8). This spell is unresistable if the target is not immune to magic or it can otherwise be landed normally.

3.name: Noxious Deluge
3.description: Showers your target in a noxious deluge, dealing 5 Poison Damage and an additional 2 Poison Damage every 6 seconds for 30 seconds.

3.name: Kick
3.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds.

4.name: Weapon Shield
4.description: Activate to use your weapon to help shield attacks, reducing physical damage against you by 5%.

5.name: Invisibility versus Undead
5.description: Shroud a target group member in darkness, rendering them unseen by the undead for 10 minutes. This spell has a moderate chance to end early.

5.name: Lull the Dead
5.description: Placates an aggressive undead target, greatly reducing the range of their social and proximity aggro for 2 minutes. Has no effect on an already aggroed target. This ability has a slight chance to fail and cause primary and social aggro. It also has a slight chance of ending early.

6.name: Grip of Shadow
6.description: Reach into the shadows and grip your target, pulling them toward you, drawing their attention, and interrupting their casting.

7.name: Cold Protection
7.description: Ward your target against frost, increasing their Cold Resistance by 4 for 1 hour.

7.name: Focused Concentration
7.description: Greatly sharpen your concentration, granting you a 100% chance to continue casting through incoming melee attacks for 15 seconds.

7.name: Holy Protection
7.description: Wards your target against the divine, increasing their Holy Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

8.name: Grip of Agony
8.description: Causes enemy to writhe in a grip of agony, dealing 12 (L1) to 600 (L60) damage.

8.name: Life Draw
